title: Pip and the Topsy-Turvy Treasure Map
moral: When we stop and listen, we find the best treasures together.
description: Nana Hoot draws a treasure map full of opposite clues: up and down, fast and slow, hot and cold! Pip is in such a hurry that he forgets to listen, and things get very wibble-wobbly. Can Pip and Tumble follow the clues and find the treasure?

narration.text: One sunny morning, Nana Hoot had a big surprise for Pip and Tumble. A treasure map!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Listen carefully, my dears. Every clue has an opposite. Up and down. Fast and slow. Hot and cold.
Then Nana's glasses slid down... down... DOWN, to the very tip of her beak. Boop!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Treasure? Super-duper! I don't need to listen. Let's GO!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Wait for me, Pip! HONK! Oopsie-trunk!

popups.sub: up the hill, down the hill

narration.text: Clue number one said: Go UP the big hill!
But Pip wasn't listening. He zoomed the wrong way. Wheee! Down, down, DOWN he slid... BONK! Right into a bush!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Wibble-wobble! Is this the top of the hill?
Hmm. Is Pip at the top of the hill, or at the bottom?
The bottom! Silly Pip! UP is the opposite of DOWN. Up, up, UP we go!

narration.text: At the top of the hill was a wibbly-wobbly rope bridge over a bubbly brook.
Clue number two said: Go SLOW on the bridge, not FAST!
But did Pip listen? Nooo! ZIP! He ran super-duper fast. Boing! Boing! BOING! went the bridge.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Uh-oh! My tail is all tangled up! I'm a fox pretzel!

narration.text: Should we go fast or slow on a wobbly bridge? What do you think?
Slow! You're so smart! Slow is safe on a wobbly bridge.
So Tumble went slow. Step... step... step. And he gently untangled his friend.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: There you go, Pip. Slow and steady!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Thanks, Tumble! Hee-hee, my tail tickles!

popups.sub: the sun is hot, ice is cold

narration.text: Next, Nana Hoot fluttered down with clue number three.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: The treasure hides somewhere COLD. Not hot. Cold! Are you listening, Pip?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Cold? Easy peasy! The opposite of cold is... spicy!
Spicy? Hee-hee! No, Pip! The opposite of COLD is HOT. Like the big, hot sun!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Spicy! Oh dear, there go my glasses again!

narration.text: Suddenly, they heard a funny sound. GRRRUMBLE! Was it a bear?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! That's just my tummy. HONK!
Everyone giggled. Then Pip stood very still, and listened with his big fox ears.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Sorry I didn't listen, Tumble. Let's listen together. Shhh...
Trickle, trickle, splish! A cold stream! Clever listening, friends!

narration.text: And there, in the cold, cold water, sat a little picnic basket!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Treasure! I'll grab it all by my... wait. Tumble, what do you think?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Let's lift it together. Up, up, UP!
Pip listened. And together, they lifted the basket UP, out of the cold water. SPLOOSH!

narration.text: But the lid was stuck! Then Tumble's trunk began to twitch. AH... AH... AH-CHOOOO!
WHOOSH! The lid flew up, up, UP into the sky, and Pip's ears flipped inside out!
Inside were cold, juicy watermelon slices, and a little note: Share with a friend who listens.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: The biggest slice is for you, Tumble. You're the best listener!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Yummmmy! Thank you, Pip!

narration.text: That evening, the friends had a picnic on top of Clover Hill. Let's remember!
What is the opposite of UP?
DOWN! Yay! And what is the opposite of FAST?
SLOW! You're a super-duper opposites expert!

narration.text: And I learned to listen first. Listening is the best treasure!

narration.text: Later, Nana Hoot told a bedtime story... and her eyes went slowly closed. Zzzz.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm awake!
Pip and Tumble giggled and snuggled under the twinkly stars.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Good night, Nana. Good night, Pip. HONK! Oops... Shhh!
